Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Demo — technical run + governance review

Tom — thanks again for the time earlier. Per our notes, we have the live demo scheduled for Monday, Jun 20 at 10:00 AM PT (60 minutes). Agenda: 1) quick product walkthrough (25m) 2) technical Q&A (20m) 3) next steps & MAM (15m).

Can you confirm the attendee list so we make sure the right engineers and procurement materials are on hand? If security or procurement need a longer slot, we can look to expand or move — just a heads up.

Irene Choi

irene.choi@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192

Date: Sun, 13 Jun 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo — technical run + governance review

Irene — thanks, appreciate the agenda. Heads up: we've added Security and Procurement to the review. Security (security_ops) wants a walkthrough of data flows and audit logging; Procurement wants to run through our MSA + a short checklist. Given that, the current 60-minute slot will be tight. Could we either:

- Move to a 90-minute slot the same week, or
- Push to the week of Jun 28 where more of our governance folks are available (security lead will be on travel the 21–25)

I've attached the procurement questionnaire (lightly filled) so you can see what they'll ask. Let me know the team's availability — Sarah and I prefer afternoons PT.

—Tom
Tom Ellis

tom@bluepeak.com | +1 (206) 555-0148
